_doc: Data-driven config + menu for workflow-systray. GHA status via ntfy SSE (fallback: gh CLI poll). Dagu status/trigger via plain REST (WG mesh is the auth model, no bearer token). sections/items mirror cloud-cp.json's shell/open/xdg dispatch types.
_ntfyTopic_comment: Found in ~/git/cloud/a_solutions/infra-obs_ntfy/build.json .topics[] — already defined: { name: dev_gha-status, title: 'GHA Run Status', desc: 'Latest GitHub Actions run status per repo (cloud/unix/front/vault/tools)' }. Not a placeholder — matches this tray's use case exactly. Confirm with Diego before shipping in case a sibling agent's ntfy-publisher work names it differently.
_daguBaseUrl_comment: oci-apps WG mesh IP:port, not https://workflows.diegonmarcos.com — Caddy proxies that public domain with proxy.primary.auth: two_factor (Authelia), which would require a bearer/2FA session the tray does not implement. Dagu's own build.json declares api.auth: none — i.e. dagu trusts network-layer auth (WG membership), matching this desktop's WG peer membership (ii4FHx). Going WG-internal keeps the 'no auth headers' contract from the task spec.
